header: Every entry runs under `--mode rust`. Tier `rust-only` runs through the rust-mode direct-host fixture and skips itself when Cargo or the fixture is unavailable; tier `pi-smoke` runs the Pi RPC process under Node and skips itself when Pi, node, or the built extension is unavailable.

entries.rationale: replay-class prefix stability: pure-defer growth (A1), defer passes after an execute pass (A2), and aged ctx_reduce survival (A3) through the incident-pool verifiers
defer-pass byte-stability of the system block and the retained message prefix
baseline-green incident variants executed in isolation through the incident-pool runner
the Pi RPC process loads the built extension, completes one mock turn with ctx_search, ctx_memory, and ctx_note registered, and leaves no storage file in the isolated data directory
an agent ctx_reduce drop enters the daemon queued-drop ledger and is consumed on the next producer-backed bust
served messages arrays keep tool_use ids unique when a queued drop is consumed
failure-mode drill 2: host crash mid-session keeps serving raw passes with a loud module failure and no placeholders
failure-mode drill 3: passes are served from the transform again after the host restarts, without restarting the session
failure-mode drill 5: a paused host produces a transport timeout served raw, and passes recover after SIGCONT
content pressure past the execute threshold lands a fold whose m0 shrinks the provider wire
historian producer reaches the controlled backend and records a typed backend failure without killing a provider process
large provider-visible tail stays intact across one-page reuse and bounded multi-page retransmission
passes are served from transform again after a host restart or crash
passes are served from transform again after a mid-session message is reverted
rust mode boots and transforms a real session through the host transport
retained wire messages are byte-identical across defer passes
passes are served from transform again after the newest user message is mutated in place
thinking-block wire safety: no nudge text in a signed assistant, dropped text shells, and image parts under whole-arc history
